coverFrac.note: v1 is shipped; v2 measured alongside per the design spec. Cover is the share of 1 m pixels at or above the threshold.

method: Kolkata fetch-canopy.py _generate: 10 m cells, 0..4 instances per cell scaling with height against a fixed 30 m reference, deterministic jitter. Tree COUNT is a display scaling, not a measurement; canopy HEIGHT is measured. Species drawn as Kolkata's: hash01(col, row, kk, 3) over its SPECIES tuple.
